selection: Highest AlpacaEval LC among the four completed single-copy M2 configurations.

missing.reason: Symlink target on previous container root disk is absent on the new CPU server; weights and original model-directory metadata unavailable.

excluded: All model weight shards (the best M2 checkpoint is missing; surviving predecessor checkpoints are not part of the Git data archive).
Credentials, config.env, judge.env, private keys, environment/cache directories.
Other M2 variants raw training/evaluation data; their completed comparison is included.
qa3 and qa4, which were not used in this run.

files.source: Derived from archived AlpacaEval annotations; no model generation or judgement rerun.
files.transformation: Project instruction/output_1/generator_1 and order by M2_ge_filter model_outputs.json.

storage.duplicate_policy: Byte-identical source files share one stored payload; all original paths and SHA-256 hashes are retained.
storage.compression: Files above 1 MiB use deterministic gzip except AlpacaEval model_outputs.json and reference_outputs.json, which remain directly downloadable.
